note: Adapted from the species-level description no. 164 in Chhotani (1997), The Fauna of India: Isoptera. Original in English; the three castes are available, nymphs are lacking; synonymic lists, bibliographic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, sides slightly convex, width usually less than three-quarters of the length; mandibles long, strongly incurved at the apex, about three-quarters of the head length, finely serrate; labrum subpentagonal, anterior margin produced forward at the middle; postmentum rod-like, waist slightly incurved; worker antennae 13-segmented, 2nd segment equal to the sum of the 3rd and 4th.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow; antennae paler than the head capsule; mandibles dark reddish brown, paler at the base; body yellowish white. Head sparsely pilose, body more densely pilose. Body length 4.0–5.0 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides slightly convex (to mandible base 1.0–1.27 mm, maximum width 0.75–0.90 mm); width usually less than three-quarters of the length (width/length ratio 0.68–0.75). Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented; 3rd segment shortest. Labrum subpentagonal, anterior margin produced forward at the middle (length 0.17–0.22 mm, width 0.15–0.27 mm). Mandibles long, strongly incurved at the apex (length 0.70–0.95 mm); about three-quarters of the head length (left mandible length/head length ratio 0.70–0.79); finely serrate. Postmentum rod-like, waist slightly incurved, slightly longer than half the head length (length 0.60–0.65 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.32 mm, waist width 0.24–0.26 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a distinct notch, posterior margin slightly concave (length 0.23–0.30 mm, width 0.51–0.60 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellow; body pale yellowish white. Head and body moderately pilose. Body length 4.4–4.8 mm. Head subsquare (to mandible base 0.85–0.90 mm, maximum width 0.85–0.87 mm). Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented, 2nd segment equal to the sum of the 3rd and 4th. Postclypeus convex, pilose; length equal to or slightly more than half its width. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.17–0.25 mm, width 0.50–0.59 mm); anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin slightly depressed at the middle.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and pronotum dark brown; antennae, postclypeus and dorsal abdomen brown. Head moderately pilose, pronotum more densely pilose than the head. Head capsule subsquare, sides nearly straight (to mandible base 0.77–0.84 mm, width including compound eyes 0.83–0.93 mm). Compound eyes subcircular, small, not strongly protruding (maximum diameter 0.18–0.21 mm, minimum diameter 0.17–0.18 mm); separated from the lower margin of the head by about their diameter. Ocelli small, punctiform (diameter 0.05–0.06 mm); separated from the compound eye by twice their diameter (0.09–0.12 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; 3rd segment shortest; 2nd segment longer than the 3rd and 4th combined. Postclypeus pilose, convex, half as long as wide. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal (length 0.44–0.48 mm, width 0.64–0.76 mm); anterior margin slightly raised and slightly concave at the middle; posterior margin slightly concave.
